flatRatePerTerm.residencyLabelScope: The flat-rate source table explicitly names New Jersey and out-of-state residents. Do not infer a special-population rate without its applicable policy.

exclusions: Textbooks and course materials are separate.
TECEP and PLA registrations are excluded from flat-rate tuition and from the standard residency course requirement.
Military, international, nursing, corporate-partner and other population-specific rates require their own selection.
These are published rate options, not a complete degree quote; total depends on course load, terms, provider subscriptions and applicable fees.

separateWaiverOption.reason: A residency waiver does not waive the combined alternative-source cap or establish a remaining outside course pathway; do not reduce the existing route to six TESU credits without those mappings.

timing.scope: Only courses with a separately documented AC offering can use the four-week format. This is not a four-week degree completion claim.

internalResearch.finding: The university accepts eligible original institutional credit, but this review did not establish current exact TESU General Management receiving awards for ASU Universal Learner, TEL partner institutions, Outlier or Upper Iowa/CPA Credits. No speculative options were added.

The current TESU edX page restricts use by TESU students to its AAS Computer Studies and BA Computer Science programs. It also lists expired ASU and Doane reviews. These tables cannot be used to fill this business degree.
TESU-issued exams and courses must keep separate residency eligibility. An exam cannot be added as an ordinary University course merely to satisfy the 15-credit residency requirement.
